liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (5 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer says it is nicely stretched out and well played; Garcia turns up reverb and goes off; Billy drums hard in a jazzy style [1][6][7][8][9][11]
- **Bertha** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it a nice opener; Reviewer calls the Bertha awesome [6][8]
- **Beat it on Down the Line** (1 review): Reviewer notes a false start at the beginning of this song [4]

## The recordings

- **gd72-05-13.sbd.ladner.3457.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 162 min; rated 3.93/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Tape has audible hiss, and the reviewer rates the sound quality a 4; Reviewer finds the hiss tolerable; the band sounds energetic and plays cleanly apart from a false start on Beat It On Down the Line; Sound is very good though not spectacular; hiss is noticeable only in quieter passages, heard on headphones [3][4][5][6][8]
- **gd72-05-13.psbd.miller.21725.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 4 songs; 50 min; rated 3.67/5 by 6 [2]

## Around the show

- Dennis McNally describes Lille as like an impressionist painting, with cows, poplars and LSD; Phil found it spectacular [13]
- Band returned to France for a make-up date; rain interrupted the show [13]
- Dennis McNally describes Lille as like an impressionist painting, with cows, poplars and LSD; Phil found it spectacular [14]
- Band returned to France for a make-up date; rain interrupted the show [14]
- Set list is standard for the period, and the band plays well despite being far from home [5]
- First set is standard for the time, tight and very good; the second-set jam goes beyond typical long jams [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd72-05-13.sbd.ladner.3457.sbeok.shnf**: source: sbd > mr > cass > dat > cda > eac > shn v3 [1]. Also: The encore, One More Saturday Night, is missing from this copy [1]
- **gd72-05-13.psbd.miller.21725.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: The Miller psbd source's playlist differs from its description, containing only Truckin', Drums, The Other One and He's Gone [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Andrieu, Philippe: [1972-05-13 ( samedi 13 mai 1972 ) Grateful Dead, Esplanade (Fairgrounds), Lille, France](http://philippe.andrieu.free.fr/concerts/19720513/005-19720513-grateful-dead.php) [16]
